summary: Replaced isDryRun() and isRunActive() private helpers with a single readLogStatus(filePath) that reads the log file once and returns { is_active, is_dry_run }.
Updated findRunLogs() to call readLogStatus() once per file instead of Promise.all([isRunActive(), isDryRun()]) — halves readFile() calls per log entry.
Updated archiveCompletedLogs() to destructure is_active from readLogStatus() instead of calling isRunActive().
All 56 log-resolver tests pass; full GUI suite (383 tests across 15 files) passes with no regressions. TypeScript compiler reports no errors.

comments.note: archiveCompletedLogs() now calls readLogStatus() which reads both first and last lines, whereas previously it only called isRunActive() (last line only). The extra first-line parse is negligible for completed files, and the unified helper eliminates the private helper surface entirely. If archival becomes a hot path, a lighter is_active-only read could be reintroduced as a targeted optimisation.

readLogStatus() is a private (non-exported) function. The existing test coverage is exercised entirely through findRunLogs(), which is sufficient. If direct unit testing of readLogStatus() is desired in future, exporting it would allow a dedicated describe block to be added without any behavioral change.

comments.note: archiveCompletedLogs() JSDoc (line 235) still references isRunActive() — stale comment only, no code impact. Could be updated to reference readLogStatus() for consistency.

No dedicated test for the combined is_dry_run: true + is_active: true case (in-progress dry run). Both flags are independently correct by design and covered individually. A combined test would add clarity but is not required for correctness.

summary: Reviewed mcp-server/src/gui/log-resolver.ts (sole modified file). WP-004 replaces isDryRun() + isRunActive() with a unified readLogStatus() private helper. 0 Critical, 0 High, 0 Medium findings. Security sign-off: PASS.

comments.note: No security findings — all OWASP Top 10 categories reviewed; no Critical or High issues identified. readLogStatus() is a private helper called exclusively from findRunLogs() and archiveCompletedLogs() with filePaths derived from readdir() output (real on-disk filenames, not user input), so omitting per-call path validation is correct and consistent with the prior isDryRun()/isRunActive() helpers it replaced.

A01 — Access Control: readLogStatus() receives constructed paths from readdir() results only; no user-supplied path flows through this helper. Attack surface is identical to the helpers it replaced. Pre-existing known limitation (no path.isAbsolute() guard on logsDir/sourceDir) is documented in the module header and predates this WP.

A03 — Injection: JSON.parse() is used to parse JSONL file content. Result is accessed only for boolean flag extraction (action === 'run_start' && dry_run === true; action !== 'run_end'). No property assignment to the parsed object — no prototype pollution risk. Fail-safe defaults (is_active: false, is_dry_run: false) on any I/O or parse error are correct and unchanged from prior behaviour.

summary: PASS — clean refactor. readLogStatus() consolidation is architecturally correct: single responsibility, fail-safe defaults on all error paths, correct Promise.all() usage for the batch read in findRunLogs(). Two-phase first-line/last-line parsing is logically sound and all edge cases (empty file, malformed JSON on either line) are handled. archiveCompletedLogs() reads one extra line per file (first line for is_dry_run) versus the prior isRunActive()-only call, but this is a documented and acceptable trade-off — the unified helper eliminates the two-helper surface entirely.
One Fix-Forward applied: stale JSDoc in archiveCompletedLogs() still referenced isRunActive() — updated to readLogStatus() / is_active: true to match the current implementation.

comments.note: Updated archiveCompletedLogs() JSDoc bullet from '**Skips** files where `isRunActive()` returns `true`' to '**Skips** files where `readLogStatus()` returns `is_active: true`'. The prior wording referenced the deleted helper — a non-behavioral one-line doc fix.

readLogStatus() uses an early `if (lines.length > 0)` block followed by a separate `if (lines.length === 0)` check. Logically correct — the second check is the empty-file early return — but structuring it as a single guard at the top (empty-check first) would improve linearity. Not worth a rework cycle; flagged for future revision.
